7.content: ... ... that they were opened to receive the waste.

spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Ten Operations of Divine Truth by Its Advent

**¶1:** Divine truth in its emissary function accomplished ten complete spiritual operations by its coming into the mind.

**¶2:** The first: The ordering power of Divine Wisdom came forth to construct a new interior state — a new dispensation of the spiritual mind.

**¶3:** The second: The containing forms of celestial good and spiritual truth moved through the highest interior degrees of understanding — love and faith in their pure vessels began to operate through the inmost heavens of the mind.

**¶4:** The third: The cyclical operations of providence began to transmit spiritual life downward into the natural mind and upward into the celestial degrees.

**¶5:** The fourth: [GAP-1: ...] *(The spiritual sequence — building, conveying, circulating — requires here an operation concerning the ordering or arrangement of these transmissions; most likely the establishment of distinct degrees or the fixing of the forms through which influx proceeds.)*

**¶6:** The fifth concerns the receiving capacities of the vessels of good and truth — that they were opened [GAP-2: ...] — the interior forms by which love and faith carry redeemed life were made accessible, so that what had been held captive within falsity could be drawn upward.

**¶7:** The sixth concerns the receiving capacities likewise [GAP-3: ... ...that they were opened to take in what is spiritually rejected] — the same containing forms were opened on their lower aspect to receive and remove spent falsities and consumed evils from the interiors of the mind.

**¶8:** The seventh is [GAP-4: REVIEW — the separated evil], which had been distinguished and cast out from the governing affections by the operation of divine truth; it precipitated downward into the natural and external degree of the mind. *(The spiritual sense requires that what the ruling loves had harbored interiorly — hidden evil — was now exposed and exteriorized, falling into the outermost plane where it could be recognized and confronted.)*

**¶9:** The eighth: States of spiritual obscurity and states of spiritual illumination were distinguished from one another [GAP-5: ... ...] *(The separation of night and day corresponds to the mind's newfound ability to discern falsity from truth, darkness of ignorance from the light of understanding — likely the gap specifies the manner or further effect of this discernment.)*

**¶10:** The ninth: The malformed and abortive conceptions of spiritual life — those quasi-goods and distorted affections that evil produces when exposed to the light of truth — [GAP-6: REVIEW — precipitated] into the natural plane of the mind. *(These are not true births of the spirit but monstrous forms generated when the governing evils, confronted by divine truth, release what they cannot hold; they fall into the external mind as recognizable distortions.)*

**¶11:** The tenth: Successive changes of state and transfers of affection came about throughout the natural degree of life — the external mind entered into the condition of continual alternation, where loves pass through form after form, unable to rest until they are either elevated toward interior good or dissipated.

---

**Structural note:** The ten operations describe a complete sequence of spiritual regeneration viewed from the side of influx: first the new state is established (1), then the vessels of good and truth begin operating (2–3), the cycles of providence are set in motion (4), the interior forms are opened both to receive redeemed life upward (5) and to expel falsity downward (6), hidden evil is exteriorized (7), truth and falsity are distinguished (8), malformed spiritual productions fall to the natural plane (9), and finally the natural mind enters into the condition of successive states — the perpetual alternation that characterizes life in the external degree before full regeneration (10).

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The Ambassador performed ten works by his advent.
The first: The Great Builder came forth to build the new aeon.
The second: The ships moved through the heights in the heavens.
The third: The wheels begin to send the life to earth and the upper worlds.
The fourth: [The zodiac was set in order]
The fifth is the doors of the ships, that they were opened up [to receive the light]
The sixth is the doors too [of the depths below, that they were opened to receive the waste]
The seventh is [the sin], which he had separated from the rulers by cause of the Third Ambassador; it fell upon the earth.
The eighth: Night and day were separated [from one another by the turning of the sphere]
The ninth: The abortions [fell] to the ground.
The tenth: Transmigrations came about in the zone.

fills.fill: The zodiac was set in order
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading calls for "the fixing of the forms through which influx proceeds," which in Manichaean cosmology corresponds precisely to the zodiac — the fixed celestial signs through which cosmic influence flows — the standard fourth work of the Third Ambassador after the new aeon, ships, and wheels.

The spiritual reading specifies that the doors were opened so that "what had been held captive within falsity could be drawn upward," which in Manichaean vocabulary is the purified light drawn up through the ships (sun and moon), contrasting with the waste received in ¶7.

fills.fill: of the depths below, that they were opened to receive the waste
fills.original: ... ... that they were opened to receive the waste.
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading specifies "the same containing forms were opened on their lower aspect to receive and remove spent falsities," which in Manichaean cosmology corresponds to the doors of the depths below — the counterpart to the upward-opening doors of the ships in ¶6, receiving the waste matter expelled downward during purification.

The spiritual reading's "separated evil" is precisely "the sin" (ⲡⲛⲟⲃⲉ) in standard Manichaean vocabulary — the sinful matter separated from the archons by the Third Ambassador's operation and cast down to earth; the editor's choice is confirmed.

fills.fill: from one another by the turning of the sphere
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading requires the manner of discernment between states of illumination and obscurity; in Manichaean cosmology, night and day are separated from one another by the revolution of the cosmic sphere, which is the mechanism by which the Third Ambassador's ordering creates the alternation of light and darkness.

The spiritual reading's "precipitated into the natural plane" corresponds exactly to "fell" — the standard Manichaean term for the abortions (malformed beings) dropping to the ground when the archons are overcome by the Third Ambassador's light; the editor's choice is confirmed.
